sampling_targets.note: Exposure targets are separate from unique-hour quotas. A sampler and availability checks are not implemented by manifest validation.

identity_policy: Canonical parent/speaker/session IDs must be shared across related datasets and variants. Exact file hashes and parent interval checks do not detect unknown re-encodings or replace acoustic fingerprinting.
bandwidth_policy: Record native/enhanced provenance and externally established bandwidth evidence. A high sample-rate header alone is insufficient. Do not use 16 kHz originals as fullband real targets.
